items.title: The double dual evaluation map of a module is injective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the evaluation map of a module into its double dual is injective (statement lines 1163-1167). The proof is a complete argument: a nonzero section is separated from zero by a map from the submodule it generates into an injective module (proof lines 1169-1177), that map extends to the whole module by the extension property of injective modules, and evaluating the double dual at the extension shows that the image of the section is nonzero, which is injectivity (proof lines 1177-1179). The non-formal content is the separation argument. The claim is H2.
